Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files by appending .EXTE extension
Uses RSA-1024 public keys to encrypt AES keys for offline encryption
Ransom note instructs victims to contact attacker emails for payment
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with files encrypted by CryptoMix ransomware variant
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note emails: exte1@msgden.net, exte2@protonmail.com, exte3@reddithub.com
